entries.query: Do the seeds carry the minimum a lawful record search needs: county/state, date window, one household member?
entries.coverage: Six of six seeds carry a name only. None carries a state, a county, a birth or death year, a spouse, or a parent.
entries.consequence: Name-only searching on Peete, Wright and Harris across the United States produces coincidence, not identification. Running it and reporting the results would be exactly the random surname matching the Chairman prohibited. The correct output is this entry, not a family tree.

entries.repository: General web index (search only - no repository page could be opened)
entries.query: "Eddie Ree Peete" OR "Eddie Rae Peete" OR "Eddie Lee Peete" obituary death record
entries.coverage: Index-level search across obituary aggregators and encyclopaedic sources, all spellings of the given name, no locality filter because none was available. Returned only unrelated Peete individuals: an Edward Julian Peete Sr (Moreno Valley, California, d. 2026), an Edward Peete (b. 1931, d. 2024), an Edwin C. Peete (Tacoma), an Eddie Mae Peet (Racine, Wisconsin), and Calvin and Charlie Peete, who are public figures.
entries.consequence: No candidate. None of the returned individuals shares an anchor with SEED-03 beyond the surname, and the surname alone is not an identification.

entries.query: "Walter James Peete" OR "Walter J. Peete" death index obituary
entries.coverage: Index-level search, both name forms, no locality filter. Returned a Walter Tyrone Peete (d. 22 May 2026) and a James Morris Peete, neither of which is the name searched. One aggregator states it holds 225 Peete obituaries, which were not individually reachable.
entries.consequence: No candidate for SEED-04. A 225-record surname collection exists and remains unsearched; it is named in NEXT RECORD SOURCES.

entries.query: "Hester Wright" OR "Hester Harris Wright" death record cemetery obituary
entries.coverage: Index-level search, both name forms, no locality filter. Returned a Hester Imogene Wright (Dyersburg, Tennessee), a Hester A. Wright (Kansas), a Hester Cooke Wright (1620-1675, Plymouth colony) and a Hester Lee Wright (b. 1802, Pitt County, North Carolina). None was returned under the name as given.
entries.consequence: No candidate for SEED-01. Note without weight: Dyersburg is in Dyer County, Tennessee, roughly fifty miles from Covington in Tipton County, which appears in the unrelated CAND-01 lead. Two Tennessee place names in one session is a coincidence until a record says otherwise, and it is recorded here only so a later session does not discover it and mistake it for a finding.

entries.query: "Hattie Peete" OR "Willie Peete" census death record genealogy
entries.coverage: Index-level search, both names, no locality filter. One aggregator summary described an Elmer Peete, said to be born 16 December 1930 near Covington, Tennessee and to have died 16 February 2001 in Missouri, named as the son of a Willie Peete and a Hattie Whitley. Also returned Willie Peete the football coach (d. aged 87), who is a different, public individual.
entries.consequence: Recorded as candidate CAND-01 against SEED-05 and NOT accepted. The source page itself was unreachable, no record was seen, and nothing connects the household to the Chairman's line. It is a lead for a session that has a locality to test it against.

entries.query: "Eugene Wright" "Kid Wright" obituary death record genealogy
entries.coverage: Index-level search pairing the given name with the nickname, no locality filter. Returned Eugene Joseph Wright the jazz bassist (1923-2020), Chalky Wright and Billy Wright the boxers, and an unrelated Eugene Wright (1960-2026, Goose Creek, South Carolina). No individual was returned under the nickname "Kid Wright".
entries.consequence: No candidate for SEED-02. The nickname is the only distinguishing term available and it returns public figures, which is what a nickname search does without a locality.
